original: ティトレイとロニってさ、似てるよネ
traducao: Tytree and Loni are pretty similar, huh?

original: あ？　\nそうかぁ？
traducao: Huh?\nYou think so?

original: そうだよ。\nだって……
traducao: Yup, you are!\nBecause...

original: 探したぞ、マオーーーッ！
traducao: I've been looking for you, Maooo!!

original: この船が宇宙船で、チャットが宇宙人だぁ？\nよくもそんな……
traducao: This ship is a spaceship,\nand Chat is an alien?! How dare you...

original: なにっ、宇宙船！？\n……そうだったのか！？
traducao: What, a spaceship?!\n...Is that true?!

original: っておい、待て。\nお前まで騙されるんじゃねえ！
traducao: Hey, wait a minute!\nDon't you get fooled too!

original: ほーらネ♪
traducao: See what I mean~?

original: あ〜〜〜〜ったく……。\nアッシュの奴！！
traducao: Gaaaaah, seriously...\nThat damn Asch!!

original: 何だよ、また喧嘩か？\nほんっとお前ら、毎日そればっかだなぁ
traducao: What, another fight?\nYou guys seriously do that every day.

original: うっせぇ！　俺は悪くねえ！！\nあいつが、事あるごとに\n俺につっかかってきやがんだ
traducao: Shut up! I didn't do anything wrong!\nHe picks a fight with me\nover every little thing!

original: ったく、言いたい事があんなら、\nネチネチ嫌味たれてねーで、\nハッキリ言ってこいっつーの！
traducao: Jeez! If he has something to say,\nsay it straight instead of whining\npetty sarcasm at me!

original: アッシュ、だっけか？\nあいつも素直じゃなさそうだからなぁ
traducao: Asch, was it?\nHe doesn't seem like the honest type.

original: なあ、たまには口喧嘩じゃなくて\n思い切って殴り合いの喧嘩でも\nしてみたらどうだ？
traducao: Hey, instead of bickering,\nwhy not just settle it\nwith a good old fistfight?

original: はぁ？
traducao: Huh?!

original: 何で俺が、ンな野蛮で面倒な事\nわざわざやんなきゃなんねーんだ
traducao: Why the hell would I bother\ndoing something so barbaric?

original: 世の中にはさ、\n自分の気持ちを言葉で表現すんのが\n得意じゃねえ奴だっているんだよ
traducao: Look, some folks out there\njust aren't good at putting\ntheir feelings into words.

original: だから、そういう時は\n直接拳で語り合っちまえばいい
traducao: So in times like that,\nlet your fists talk directly!

original: 男同士だからこそ\n伝わるもんってーのは、あると思うぜ
traducao: Between men, there are things\nthat can only be said with fists.

original: ……そういうあんたは\nやった事あんのかよ？
traducao: ...Have you ever done that\nyourself, then?

original: おう。\nもちろんだぜ！
traducao: Yeah.\nOf course I have!

original: 力づくってのは、あんま好きじゃねーけど\n一発ぶん殴ってやらねえと\n大事なモンに気付けない奴もいっからよ
traducao: I'm not big on brute force,\nbut some guys won't notice what matters\nunless you punch some sense into 'em!

original: そういう……もんなのか？
traducao: Is that... how it works?

original: そういうもんだよ
traducao: That's exactly how it works.

original: ちっ……面倒くせえ
traducao: Tch... What a pain in the ass.

original: はぁあぁぁぁ〜〜〜〜……
traducao: Haaaahhhhhh......

original: あれ？\n珍しいね、ティトレイが落ち込んでる
traducao: Huh?\nHow rare, Tytree is depressed.

original: 何かあったのでしょうか？
traducao: Did something happen?

original: 変なモノでも食って\n腹壊したとかじゃないのか？
traducao: Did he eat something weird\nand upset his stomach?

original: その可能性は低いと思います
traducao: I believe that is unlikely.

original: ティトレイさんの性格でしたら、\n本当に体調不良になっていれば\n周りに症状を訴えて大騒ぎするはずです
traducao: Given Tytree's personality,\nif he were truly feeling ill,\nhe would be loudly complaining to all.

original: す、すずの分析は容赦ないなぁ……
traducao: S-Suzu's analysis is ruthless...

original: 忍者とはそういうものです。\nいついかなる時も、冷静な判断を\n下せなければ務まりません
traducao: Such is the way of the ninja.\nOne must exercise calm judgment\nat all times.

original: へえ、大変なんだな……
traducao: Whoa, tough job...

original: ……じゃなくて。\n本当に具合が悪いなら医務室に連れてったり\nした方がいいんじゃないのか？
traducao: ...Wait, no!\nIf he's really unwell, shouldn't we\ntake him to the infirmary?

original: ああ、気にしない気にしない
traducao: Ah, don't mind him, don't mind him!

original: いつもの発作が起きてるだけだヨ
traducao: He's just having his usual fit!

original: 発作？
traducao: A fit?

original: ティトレイって、持病があったのか？
traducao: Does Tytree have a chronic condition?

original: あはは、まあ、持病みたいなものかな？\nあれは一生治らないと思うから\n気にする事ないって
traducao: Ahaha, kind of like that!\nI don't think it'll ever be cured,\nso there's no need to worry!

original: そう……なんですか？
traducao: Is that... how it is?

original: う、ううう……
traducao: U-Uuuugh...

original: 姉貴ィ……
traducao: Big siiiis...

original: ジュディスって、色っぽいよなあ……！
traducao: Judith is so damn sexy...!

original: なあ、話した事あるか？
traducao: Hey, have you ever talked to her?

original: え？\nそりゃ、挨拶とかはした事あっけど……
traducao: Eh?\nI mean, I've said hi to her, but...

original: マジかよ！！\nどんな人なんだ？　\nなあ、なあ？
traducao: For real?!\nWhat's she like?\nCome on, tell me, tell me!

original: う〜ん。　そうだな。\n落ち着いてるし、頭もいいし\n人当たりもソフトで、こう
traducao: Hmm, let's see.\nShe's calm, smart, gentle with people,\nkind of like...

original: 大人の女性〜って感じだな
traducao: a mature woman, I'd say.

original: おまけに美人だしな！
traducao: Plus, she's gorgeous!

original: ああ、美女に悪い人はいない！
traducao: Right! No gorgeous woman is ever evil!

original: 同感だ
traducao: Agreed.

original: ま、おれの姉貴の方が美人だけどな
traducao: Though my big sis is even prettier.

original: やっぱそれなのかよッ！？
traducao: Of course you'd bring her up!!

original: えっと、リカルド……だったよな？
traducao: Um, Ricardo... right?

original: ……そうだが。\n何か用か
traducao: ...Yes.\nDo you need something?

original: いや、用って程の用じゃないんだけどさ。\n新しい仲間に挨拶すんのは、礼儀だろ
traducao: Nah, no real business.\nGreeting a new ally is just courtesy!

original: ……ふっ。\n礼儀、か
traducao: ...Hmph.\nCourtesy, is it?

original: おめでたい発想だな。\n随分と恵まれた環境で育ったと見える
traducao: Naive thinking.\nYou must have grown up pampered.

original: おっ、わかるか？
traducao: Oh, can you tell?

original: おれの姉貴がデキた人でさ〜、\nおかげで、誰からも「気さくないい奴」って\n言われるまでに育ったんだよなぁ！
traducao: My big sis is amazing, y'see!\nThanks to her, everyone calls me\na friendly, good guy!

original: にしても、広い船だよな〜
traducao: Still, this ship is huge, huh~

original: こんだけの設備を持ったギルドとなると\n文句なしに“四つ星”級だぜ！
traducao: A guild with facilities like this\nis easily 4-star class, no question!

original: その評価制度、まだ生きてたんだネ……
traducao: That rating system is still alive...?

original: ねえ、四つ星……って\nどういう意味なの？
traducao: Um, what does\n'four stars' mean?

original: ティトレイ独特の評価の仕方なんだヨ。\n最低ランクが一つで、\n最大が、星五つまであるんだって
traducao: It's Tytree's unique rating scale.\nLowest rank is one star,\nand the max is five stars!

original: ノンノンノン！　\nマオ、忘れたのか？
traducao: Non, non, non!\nDid you forget, Mao?

original: 最低なモンには、\n星一個たりともやれないんだぜ。\nここ、重要だからな
traducao: The absolute worst things\ndon't even get a single star!\nThat part is crucial!

original: そうだっけ……？\n正直、どっちでもいい気がするけど
traducao: Was it...?\nHonestly, I don't think it matters.

original: 何言ってんだ！　\n星を取るってのはな、\n並大抵の事じゃねえんだぞ？
traducao: What're you saying?!\nEarning a star\nis no ordinary feat, y'know!

original: そう簡単にやれるもんじゃねえんだ
traducao: It ain't something given out easily!

original: よくわからないけど……。\nそこが重要なのは、よく伝わったよ
traducao: I don't really get it, but...\nI understand that it's important!

original: おっ、エミルも使いたくなったか？\n遠慮しないでバンバン使ってくれよな！
traducao: Oho, you wanna use it too, Emil?\nDon't be shy, rate things all you want!

original: う……か、考えておくよ
traducao: Ugh... I-I'll think about it.

original: エミルって面白い力を持ってるよなぁ。\nなぁ、それって生まれ付きなのか？
traducao: You have an interesting power, Emil.\nWere you born with that?

original: えっ……
面白い力って……\n戦闘している時の僕の事……だよね？
traducao: An interesting power...\nYou mean... me during battle, right?

original: ああ、もちろん
traducao: Yeah, of course!

original: 何せ、あんだけキャラが変わると\nほとんど別人だからなぁ！
traducao: With your personality flipping that much,\nyou're practically a different person!

original: ……あの力は……、\n生まれ付きなんかじゃないよ。\n上手く、説明出来ないんだけど……
traducao: ...That power...\nisn't something I was born with.\nI can't explain it well, though...

original: へえ〜。\nんじゃ、後から手に入れた\n特別な力ってワケか
traducao: Oho~\nSo it's a special power\nyou obtained later on, then!

original: ……変な奴だって、思う？\n僕の事……
traducao: ...Do you think I'm weird?\nFor being like that...?

original: 変？　\n逆だろ？
traducao: Weird?\nMore like the opposite!

original: 自分が二通り味わえて面白えじゃねえか！\n何だか得した感じだな！！
traducao: Getting to experience being two people\nis awesome! Feels like a bonus!!

original: ……ティトレイって……その……\nちょっと……変わってるよね？
traducao: ...Tytree... um...\nyou're kind of... unusual, aren't you?

original: ははははは！　そうかぁ？\nエミルに言われるとは\n思わなかったけどなぁ
traducao: Hahahahaha! You think so?\nNever thought I'd hear that from you,\nEmil!

original: （……二通りの自分……か……）
traducao: (...Two people in one... huh...?)

original: マルタのその髪飾り、キレイだなぁ。\n造花か？
traducao: That hair ornament of yours is pretty.\nIs it an artificial flower, Marta?

original: えっ？　\nそ、そうだけど……
traducao: Eh?\nY-Yeah, it is, but...

original: どうして造花だってわかったの？\nみんな、本物の花と間違えるのに
traducao: How did you know it was artificial?\nEveryone usually mistakes it for real.

original: そりゃあなあ。\n花弁のツヤを見れば、それくらいはな
traducao: Well, y'know.\nOne look at the petal gloss tells me that.

original: 何より、この季節に\n咲いてる花じゃねえだろ？
traducao: Besides, that flower doesn't bloom\nin this season, right?

original: 意外……。\nティトレイって、花に詳しいんだ
traducao: Surprising...\nYou know a lot about flowers, Tytree.

original: 意外とは何だ、意外とは。\nこう見えて、草木に関する知識には\nちっとばかし自信があるぜ
traducao: What's with the 'surprising'?!\nI happen to be pretty confident\nin my botanical knowledge!

original: ボーボーの雑草頭は\n伊達じゃないって事ね……
traducao: Guess that wild weed-head of yours\nisn't just for show, then...

original: まぁな。\n何事も自然が一番！\nだろ？
traducao: You bet.\nNature's best for everything!\nRight?

original: 別に、今のは褒めたワケじゃ\nないんだけど……
traducao: I wasn't really complimenting you\njust now, though...

original: しっかし、この船にはいい奴が多いなぁ。\nみんな話しやすいし、親切だし……
traducao: Man, there're so many great folks here.\nEveryone's easy to talk to and kind...

original: そういえば、ティトレイは\n色んな奴と話をしているよな……
traducao: Come to think of it, Tytree,\nyou talk to all kinds of people...

original: 誰と一番気が合うんだ？
traducao: Who do you get along with best?

original: 気の合う奴か？　\nそうだなあ……
traducao: Who I get along with?\nHmm, let's see...

original: クレスとか、スタンとか、\nシング辺りとはよく話すな
traducao: I talk a lot with Cress, Stahn,\nand Shing, I guess.

original: なんつーか、心根がまっすぐで\n話してて気持ちいいよな！
traducao: They're all so straightforward,\nit feels great talking to them!

original: ああ……。\nまっすぐというか、熱い奴らだよな
traducao: Yeah...\nMore than straightforward, they're fiery.

original: みんな、どっかの誰かに責任を\n被せるんじゃなくて、自分の行動で\n何かをどうにか変えていこうとしてる
traducao: None of them blame others;\nthey try to change things\nthrough their own actions!

original: そういう姿勢が尊敬出来んだよな。\nどこもこういう奴ばっかりだと\nいいんだけどな！
traducao: I really respect that attitude.\nIf only everyone everywhere\nwas like that!

original: なるほどな……とりあえず
traducao: I see... At any rate,

original: お前も熱い奴だという事は、\nよくわかったよ
traducao: I understand completely\nthat you're a fiery guy too.

original: おれ、思うんだけどよ……
traducao: Here's what I'm thinking...

original: ラザリスの奴は結局、一人ぼっちで\n寂しいってだけなんじゃないのか？\nだから、自分の居場所が欲しいんだよな？
traducao: Isn't Lazaris just lonely\nand all on her own?\nThat's why she wants a place to belong!

original: また唐突に\nザックリまとめて来たわね……
traducao: Way to generalize things\nso abruptly again...

original: でも、私も同じ事を考えていました。\n悪い人……では、ない様な気がします
traducao: Yet I was thinking the same thing.\nI feel she is not an evil person...

original: だとしても、よ。\nあたし達のやるべき事は\n何も変わらないわ
traducao: Even if so,\nwhat we must do\ndoesn't change at all.

original: 大体、そんな単純に\nどうこう出来る問題じゃないから\nあっちだって苦しんでるわけでしょ
traducao: Besides, it's not an issue\nthat can be solved that simply,\nwhich is why she is suffering.

original: ええ……。\nそれは、そうかもしれません
traducao: Yes...\nThat may very well be true.

original: 事は世界創世にまで関わる話です。\n根が深い分だけ、簡単に和解する事も\n出来ない……という事なんでしょう
traducao: This involves the creation of worlds.\nWith roots that deep, reconciling\nwon't be so easy, I suppose.

original: 何でだよ？\n辛い時は、お互いに助け合う。\n寂しいなら、一緒にいたいって言えばいい
traducao: Why not?!\nWhen it hurts, help each other out!\nIf lonely, just say you wanna be together!

original: おれ、何か間違った事言ってるか？
traducao: Am I saying anything wrong?!

original: 間違っては……いませんけど
traducao: You're not... wrong, but...

original: ティトレイ見てると、ほんと\nどっかのスカタンを思い出すわ……
traducao: Watching you, Tytree, really reminds me\nof a certain blockhead...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
